Definition
[Resolvent set and resolvent operator] ↗ def:semigroup-generator 1. ch7:7.4.1-def-3\group Semigroup Theory

(i) We say a real number $\lambda $ belongs to $\rho (A)$, the resolvent set of $A$, provided the operator \[ \lambda I - A : D(A) \to X \] is one-to-one and onto.

(ii) If $\lambda \in \rho (A)$, the resolvent operator $R_\lambda : X \to X$ is defined by \[ R_\lambda u := (\lambda I - A)^{-1}u. \]
